headings.rules: Use for all headings. Keep tracking tight (tracking-tight). Max size text-4xl on mobile, text-5xl on desktop.

body.rules: Clean, highly legible font for tables, forms, and OCR data.

layouts.global: Mobile-first approach. For desktop screens, constrain main content to a max-width container (e.g., max-w-lg or max-w-2xl) to mimic a mobile app feel, or use a responsive dashboard layout if appropriate. Maintain p-4 or p-6 padding on mobile.
layouts.home: Vertical stack of large, prominent action buttons (min-h-[64px]) for 'Crea Nuovo Registro' and 'Apri Registro Esistente'. Below, a list of recent registers.
layouts.register_table: Horizontal scrollable container for the table (overflow-x-auto) to accommodate configurable columns. The first column (DATA) must be sticky (sticky left-0 bg-white z-10). Include monthly total rows.
layouts.wizard_flow: Use step-by-step screens (wizard) for creating registers and the daily OCR flow (Azzeramento -> Reparti -> Conferma). Focus on one task per screen.

components.buttons: Large touch targets (h-14 or h-16) for primary actions on mobile. rounded-xl radius. Active state scaling (active:scale-[0.98]).
components.inputs: Large hit areas (h-12). rounded-lg borders. Use distinct focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:outline-none).
components.cards: Subtle shadows (shadow-sm) with 1px border (border-slate-200). rounded-2xl for a friendly, modern mobile app feel.
components.status_badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Must include BOTH color and an icon for accessibility. Inline flex, items center, gap-1.5, px-2.5, py-1, text-sm font-semibold.
components.navigation: Sticky bottom bar or simple top header (sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200) with a 'Back' button and page title.
components.icons: Use lucide-react for all standard icons.

motion.page_transitions: If using framer-motion, simple fade and slight slide-up (initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
motion.drawers_modals: Slide up from bottom for mobile (Action Sheets/Drawers) rather than centered modals when possible.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure status colors have sufficient contrast ratio (text-emerald-700 on bg-emerald-50 is WCAG AA). Do not rely solely on color to convey status; always use icons and text labels (Verificato, Da Controllare, Non Quadrato).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Italian mobile-first utility app. Use Italian for all user-facing text.
File format MUST be .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx (unless the project is natively configured for TS).
Focus heavily on the mobile experience: large inputs, clear validation, prominent buttons.

For the OCR / Camera flow, simulate a camera interface or provide a stylized upload area. For the confirmation screen, display a split view or card showing the extracted values vs the expected totals, allowing manual overrides with big, tappable input fields.
For the Register Table, ensure the 'Data' column is sticky on the left during horizontal scroll. Implement the monthly tabs for navigation.

The Reconciliation (Quadratura) logic is critical: show a clear Result Card. If Totale Azzeramento != Totale Reparti, show NON_QUADRATO (Red) or DA_CONTROLLARE (Yellow). If they match, show VERIFICATO (Green).
Use Shadcn UI components where possible, but customize their classes to match the rounded-xl mobile friendly aesthetic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or .tsx.
